questions.q: Why was Al-Walid called Al-Wahid, the single one?
options: Because he alone bore the cost of the Kaaba's covering
Because he was an only child
questions.explain: Al-Walid alone bore the cost of the Kaaba's covering, the decorated cloth over the Kaaba.

questions.q: What happened when the Prophet SAW recited Surah An-Najm before the Kaaba?
questions.explain: Al-Walid was captivated by the Quran but was arrogant and refused to prostrate.

questions.q: Who was the blind companion who came to learn the Quran, leading to the revelation of Surah Abasa?
questions.explain: Allah told him to give attention to the one who truly wanted to learn.

questions.q: What label did Al-Walid finally choose for the Prophet SAW?
questions.explain: Al-Walid rejected liar and madman, then chose sorcery. The Prophet's own enemies admitted he was neither a liar nor insane.

questions.q: Why did some companions return from Abyssinia to Makkah?
options: Because of a false report that Makkah had become Muslim
Because they ran out of food
Because the Prophet SAW summoned them
questions.explain: The report was untrue and caused hardship. We must be careful with news.

questions.q: What did Mus'ab do when his mother offered him wealth to leave the Prophet SAW?
options: He refused and did not leave him
questions.explain: Mus'ab was driven out without wealth wearing patched clothes, but his faith came first.

questions.q: Where was Abu Bakr beaten by a crowd until he was bruised?
questions.explain: Abu Bakr was beaten by a crowd in front of the Kaaba.

questions.q: What title would later be given to Khalid bin Al-Walid?
questions.explain: Khalid was trained in riding and archery, later embraced Islam and was called the Sword of Allah.

questions.q: The report that everyone in Makkah had embraced Islam was true.
questions.explain: False. The report was false and caused suffering.

questions.q: The more Abu Jahal forbade people from listening, the more wanted to hear the Prophet SAW.
Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Mus'ab is driven out by his mother
Al-Walid searches for a label for him

questions.explain: An-Najm was recited, Al-Walid searched for a label, companions returned, Mus'ab was driven out, and Abu Bakr was beaten.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The place the Prophet SAW headed to avoid Khalid
The decorated cloth covering the Kaaba

questions.explain: An-Najm means the star, Al-Wahid the single one, the kiswa the cloth covering the Kaaba, and Hudaybiyyah the place where the Prophet SAW avoided Khalid.
